function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies the customer's identity using verification type (Aadhaar last 4) and value. The call is restricted until verified.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer in the database. Use 'CUST_9988' for Rahul Sharma.

verification_type.description: The verification method used to authenticate the customer.

verification_value.description: The digits or value provided by the user. For Rahul, the correct last 4 digits of Aadhaar are '1234'.
